caption:
THE MOST STYLISH SHONEN
Manga fashion done right.

Bleach never treated clothing as filler. Tite Kubo dresses every character from the inside out—even when they share a uniform, a season or a color.

01 — UNIFORM
One uniform. Five attitudes. Open collars, loose ties, rolled sleeves and one bare foot pushed into the foreground.

02 — WINTER
Layers show personality. Heavy scarves, gloves, high collars and oversized coats turn clothing into silhouette.

03 — VALENTINE’S
One theme. Different outfits. White tailoring, red tartan, mint green and chocolate hearts make the palette feel shared, never repeated.

04 — SUMMER
All white. Never the same.

That is why Bleach still reads like a lookbook: the clothes do not interrupt the character design. They are the character design.

Bleach, 2001–2016 — Tite Kubo
